rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion assignment to produce a controlling, administrable rule rejecting Marks-based reliance on Kennedy’s Rapanos concurrence and adopting a relatively-permanent-waters plus continuous-surface-connection test. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito (to press textualism/federalism and critique agency discretion) and from Kavanaugh/Barrett (to flag underinclusiveness/evasion concerns while joining the narrower rule), with a possible Kagan-led dissent emphasizing statutory structure and a cabined significant-nexus alternative.
